title: Eliz de Fleur | Event & Wedding Design Warszawa

analysis.business_context: High-end event and wedding design studio based in Warsaw specializing in scenography and immersive spatial experiences. Website acts as a digital portfolio and lead-generation tool.
analysis.audience: Affluent clients seeking bespoke event/wedding design (corporate, private), event planners, possibly venues, and design-conscious audience valuing visual storytelling and artistic flair.
analysis.conversion_goal: Primary: Lead generation via contact form. Secondary: Portfolio showcasing to build credibility and inspire trust through visual documentation of work.
analysis.first_viewport_logic: Hero combines a strong manifesto statement with a split-quad image collage showing standout project visuals. High-contrast black background immediately positions the brand as bold and creative while offering immediate access to portfolio and info via clear, small CTAs.
information_architecture: Recent projects grid gallery segmented by type (default: all)
Dynamic (animated) montage with positioning on movement/scale
Process highlight with emphasis on detail
analysis.narrative_storytelling: Relies on juxtaposing emotive copy and tightly curated project photography to tell a story of experience, memory, and transformation. Copy is poetic yet concise, always relating back to what the studio uniquely delivers.
analysis.composition_grid: Desktop: Modular grid uses full-bleed zones, staggered project grids, visual columns, and large negative space. Mobile: Full-width stacking, single-column, clear rhythm maintained, grid adapts but never feels crowded.
analysis.spacing_rhythm: Ample negative space, particularly on desktop, with uncongested blocks separating headline, image, and grid sections. Breathing room between gallery items and clear margins around copy.
analysis.typography: Editorial serif headlines set large for gravitas. Paired with all-caps or minimal sans-serif for navigation and microcopy. Hierarchy is pronounced, with a premium magazine feel but digital-optimized sizing.
analysis.palette_contrast: Restricted palette: rich black, warm sand/beige, crisp white, and sparing use of hot red/pink in photography for visual punctuation. Background color-blocking used to anchor or highlight content sections.
analysis.media_treatment: Photography is the hero—images are large, uncropped, and vivid, never overlaid. Portfolio thumbnails mix color and grayscale placeholders. No visible video; movement described but not autoplayed.
analysis.motion_interaction: Very subtle: appears to use image crossfades or simple entrance transition within portfolio gallery on desktop. No complex scroll-jacking or parallax. Motion underscores content, not distracts.
analysis.cta_strategy: Intro CTAs are understated, in-line, and text-based. Primary conversion is clearly the contact form at the base, visually separated to guide completion. Gallery links encourage browsing but are secondary journeys.
analysis.desktop_behavior: Layered sections with some horizontal split layouts, persistent navigation at top, photo grids are interactive on hover (preview effects likely). Form at the base is easy to complete, not overwhelming.
analysis.mobile_behavior: Linear scroll, one-column stacking maintains all messaging and visual hierarchy. Navigation likely collapsible; project cards remain proportional. Form fields are fully accessible and touch-friendly.
learn: Editorial layouts lend authority and emotional resonance to premium creative offerings.
Restrained but strategic color blocking elevates portfolio images and directs flow without noise.
Generous spacing aids legibility and luxurious feel; never crowd impactful photos or headlines.
Image-driven grids with selective text emphasize craft without overwhelming detail.
do_not_copy: Do not crowd visuals or headlines; avoid compressing grids or copy.
Do not overdo colored accents—limit palette to background and content; let photography provide vibrancy, not UI.
Do not add unnecessary animation. Motion should be functional and subtle, not decorative.
Do not default to generic testimonials—prioritize gallery proof of work.
reusable_cross_category_traits: Contrasting editorial typography for premium effect.
Tight grid system with adaptive layout shifting (columns to stack).
Sectioned IA: story, proof (gallery), process, CTA.
Photocentric visual design with copy as supporting, not leading, element.
traits: Bold editorial layout with large serif headlines.
Negative space and clear visual rhythm.
Process transparency through dedicated narrative segments.
